name: Action for Eastern Montana, Area I Agency on Aging (Glendive)
organization: Action for Eastern Montana, Area I Agency on Aging (Glendive) (Area I)
description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: information and assistance, home-delivered and congregate meals, in-home services, transportation, caregiver support and senior legal assistance.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. The statewide line, 1-800-551-3191, also rings your local Area Agency on Aging. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
The state’s ADRC page lists the Fort Peck Reservation for Area I; the state ombudsman directory names Roosevelt County with Area I.
